description: Delete GitLab Container Registry repositories and tags. Actions: delete_repository (remove a whole repository), delete_tag (remove one tag), delete_tags_bulk (regex cleanup with keep_n/older_than retention - destructive). Related: browse_registry to inspect before deleting.

action.description: Action to perform: delete_repository, delete_tag, delete_tags_bulk

keep_n.description: Keep the N most recently created matching tags Required for 'delete_tags_bulk' action(s).

name_regex_delete.description: Regex for tag names to delete (e.g., ".*" for all, "^v.+" for version tags) Required for 'delete_tags_bulk' action(s).

name_regex_keep.description: Regex for tag names to always keep (takes precedence over name_regex_delete) Required for 'delete_tags_bulk' action(s).

older_than.description: Only delete tags created longer ago than this duration (e.g., "7d", "12h") Required for 'delete_tags_bulk' action(s).

repository_id.description: Numeric ID of the container repository (from browse_registry list_repositories)

tag_name.description: Container image tag name to delete Required for 'delete_tag' action(s).

name: manage_registry
